errors.evidence: While technically correct that there is no axis title, the description fails to mention that the y-axis represents an index value, which is evident from the legend for all three lines.

errors.evidence: The purple line is a step function and remains flat at a value of 100 from January 2015 until January 2017. There is no increase in July 2016.
In January 2017, the purple line steps up to a value of approximately 103, not 105.
In January 2019, the value of the purple line is approximately 108, not 110.
In January 2020, the value of the purple line increases to approximately 109, not 121.
The purple line does not jump in July 2020. The value remains at approximately 109.
In July 2021, the value of the purple line is approximately 112, not 150. The value of 150 is not reached until January 2025.
The light blue line terminates around July 2022 at a value of approximately 120. It does not continue to July 2025, nor does it reach a value of 146.
The dark blue line begins in late 2022 (the legend specifies October 2022), not in January 2015.
